# The "Customer Support" Agent (Executing a Read Tool)

## Prompt

```
A customer says their order is stuck. Their email is `ceo@entreprise.com`. explicitly execute the MCP tool named `get_customer_status` to find the status of their order and draft an apologetic technical email.
```

## MCP Tool Name

`get_customer_status`

## Order Status

`Delayed - item is out of stock`

## Email Draft Generated by the Agent

```
Subject: Update on your order

Hello,

I’m sorry your order has been delayed. I checked its status, and it is currently delayed because the item is out of stock.

We understand this is inconvenient. We don’t have a confirmed restock or delivery date to share yet, but we’ll update you as soon as one is available. Please reply if you’d prefer to discuss other options.

We apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience.

Best,
Customer Support
```
